name: shadcn Color Preview
summary: VS Code extension that previews shadcn HSL color values inline in CSS and other stylesheet files.
description: Displays a live color preview for colors written in shadcn's HSL CSS-variable syntax as you type, with more color information and a color mixer on hover, plus conversion utilities. Supports CSS, SCSS, LESS, PostCSS, JS/JSX, TS/TSX and TailwindCSS files; requires VS Code 1.88 or newer.
contains: inline preview of shadcn HSL color values
hover details with a color mixer
file support: CSS, SCSS, LESS, PostCSS, JS/JSX, TS/TSX, TailwindCSS
